basic_details.short_information: Kochi Metro Rail Limited (KMRL) has published the General Manager Notification 2026 on its official website, https://kochimetro.org. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 General Manager position. Candidates meeting the prescribed age criteria (up to 55 years for Regular/Deputation, up to 50 years for AGM on Deputation, and 56–62 years for Re-employment) and holding a B.E./B.Tech degree in any branch of Engineering from an AICTE/UGC-recognized University or Institute are eligible to apply online. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KMRL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the KMRL General Manager Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of KMRL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the KMRL General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the KMRL General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) recruitment is 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a B.E./B.Tech in any branch of Engineering from an AICTE/UGC recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: For the Regular and Deputation posts of GM (O&M), the maximum age limit is 55 years. For re-employment, the age range is between 56 and 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Regular Post GM (O&M) is Rs. 120000-280000 (IDA) - E8. For re-employment, the salary can be up to Rs. 1,70,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the KMRL General Manager (Operations & Maintenance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for this position in online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Kochi Metro Rail (KMRL)?
faq.answer: The official website of Kochi Metro Rail (KMRL) is https://kochimetro.org.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Kochi, Kerala.
